About MIMCO Capital

Invest, Structure, Unlock Value.
A Leading Player in Pan-European Value-Add Real Estate

MIMCO is an investment group specialized in pan-European value-add real estate.

The group structures and manages innovative investment vehicles for a clientele of institutional investors, family offices, and private banks.

With deep expertise in financial structuring, MIMCO offers a comprehensive range of solutions — from the creation of regulated investment funds to exclusive club deals, as well as tailor-made products including equity and mezzanine debt solutions.

This multidisciplinary approach enables optimized value creation while ensuring rigorous risk management.

In a constantly evolving environment, our group anticipates market trends to ensure the long-term sustainability and performance of each real estate investment.

Discover our services at MIMCO

  • Real Estate Asset Management

  • Alternative Financing

  • Real Estate Fund Management

/01

Real Estate Asset Management

Our dedicated team ensures active management of high value-add assets. Combining multi-sector expertise with in-depth on-the-ground knowledge, we sustainably enhance the value of the assets under management. Thanks to a proactive approach covering the entire value chain, we maximize the operational and financial performance of each investment, while maintaining exemplary risk control.

/02

Alternative Financing

Our team acts as a key partner to support your real estate investments. We design innovative legal and financial structures within club deals, precisely tailored to the needs of each project and the profile of each investor. This structuring expertise enables us to optimize investment returns while ensuring strict risk control, thereby strengthening the long-term stability and growth of portfolios.

/03

Real Estate Fund Management

Our team has recognized experience in the structuring and management of pan-European real estate funds. With in-depth knowledge of European real estate dynamics and a proven ability to structure large-scale international funds, we design investment strategies adapted to local realities and the strategic specificities of each vehicle. We provide rigorous asset management to sustainably maximize performance.

Let's find the right solution for your needs

Real estate is at the core of our identity, and we are determined to always aim higher and provide top‑quality investment opportunities to our partners and investors, whether in our funds or in our Club Deals.
